records.academicNote: A good bachelor with Chinese/Chinese Language and Literature or a closely related subject, or accepted equivalent. Related subjects need assessment. Putonghua/Cantonese teaching does not itself waive English evidence. Possible qualifying examination/interview; no numeric GPA or fixed work years established.

A good bachelor or equivalent; an equivalent professional qualification may also be considered. No exclusive major is established in the consulted entry section. Possible qualifying examination/interview; teaching in English, Cantonese and/or Putonghua requires readiness beyond an English score. Translation/interpreting capstones remain one taught award.

The portal requires a good bachelor/equivalent and possible writing test/interview. The CAES programme audience includes current/former English teachers and non-teaching language professionals; it does not establish a fixed work-year floor. Prior language/education experience and equivalence need assessment. Advanced standing is not a guaranteed waiver or tuition discount.

Art History major OR a bachelor in another subject with substantial art-related experience. The alternative route is assessed, not rejected because the major differs. English statement up to 1,000 words, academic/professional writing sample up to 5,000 words including notes/bibliography, CV and two referees (at least one academic); possible interview. A taught dissertation does not turn this MA into MPhil.

The programme explicitly accepts any undergraduate discipline, subject to good degree/equivalence and possible assessment/interview. Putonghua/Cantonese/English teaching readiness remains assessed. Chinese Historical Studies is the named Arts English exception: do not impose ordinary Arts IELTS 7 or TOEFL Writing 25/5. English-medium/local evidence still needs acceptance.

All disciplines are encouraged. The portal asks for an extended creative personal statement described as approximately 500-750 words, plus a PDF portfolio of at most 12 pages/5 MB; finalists interview. These are assessed materials, not profile-computable scores. The English School site contains mixed scholarship/cohort and curriculum-table text; do not turn those into fees, GPA or entry-credit requirements.

Current programme admissions names Japanese, Korean, East Asian Studies and related disciplines including Anthropology, Cultural Studies, History, Linguistics, Literature, Media Studies, Politics and Sociology. Evidence of Japanese JLPT N2+, Korean TOPIK 4+, or Russian TORFL II+ is required. The portal generic CEFL B2 wording is not a substitute for this exact language list. Two academic referees, personal statement/CV, possible test/interview remain assessed. Elective field-trip opportunities are not evidence that every student must leave Hong Kong.

Current 2027/28 School of English requirements specify English or a closely related major, although the central portal summary gives only a good bachelor. Preserve the specific major condition; related/equivalent backgrounds need assessment. A personal statement, English writing sample and possible interview are additional evidence. Old part-time pages do not create a current PT option.

Current programme admissions names European Studies and related disciplines including Anthropology, Cultural Studies, History, Linguistics, Literature, Media Studies, Politics and Sociology. Evidence of French/German/Spanish CEFR B2+ or Russian TORFL II+ is required. The portal generic CEFL B2 wording does not establish acceptance of another regional language. Two academic referees, statement/CV, possible test/interview remain assessed. Elective travel opportunities are not imposed as universal delivery.

A good bachelor majoring in Hong Kong Studies, Chinese Literature and Culture, or a related subject; related equivalence needs assessment. Possible interview. Courses are primarily English with Chinese supplementation. Do not substitute Hong Kong History, Chinese Language and Literature, or their fee/entry rules.

History major OR another bachelor with experience studying history. The experience alternative is not an automatic rejection for another degree and has no published numeric work-year substitute. The school page still says 2027/28 tuition to be confirmed and quotes 2026/27 annual PT fees; the portal proposed 2027 amount is recorded explicitly as provisional, not approved. English instruction and capstone research do not imply MPhil or assured PhD entry.

The current portal names Linguistics or a closely related subject. The department page last updated in 2025 describes that major as preferred and uses Division 2 wording; resolve the source/qualification applicability rather than converting it into a GPA or universal honours threshold. Closely related fields and qualifying examination/interview remain assessed.

The portal explicitly accepts any discipline. A mixed-year departmental page also uses BA Division 2 (2B) wording; that older lower section is not silently imposed as a current numeric GPA/honours gate. Current 2027/28 scanned checklist requires one recent English writing sample of 1,000-1,200 words with word count, Times New Roman 12, PDF; it is separate from a personal statement. Two academic referees and assessment/interview remain required evidence. Optional Literary/Cultural or Film/Media transcript streams remain one degree.

Music major OR a bachelor in another subject with relevant musical experience. The alternative cannot be rejected solely from the undergraduate title; musical experience is not an employment-years threshold. Current portal start month is To be updated. Curriculum and careers do not imply a professional licence or guaranteed admission.

A good bachelor majoring in Philosophy, Politics or Economics OR another degree with experience studying at least one of those subjects. Prior-study evidence is not a numeric employment-years test. The three fields form one PPE award, not three extra degrees or an assumed requirement to major in all three.

All fields are welcomed; Arts/Humanities backgrounds are encouraged rather than mandatory. Current checklist requires original English creative work/work in progress up to 10 pages/5 MB and a separate 250-300-word personal statement. Shortlisted candidates interview. Do not copy Creative Communications 12-page portfolio or its 500-750-word statement into this MFA. The creative dissertation remains part of a taught master.

boundaries.language: Ordinary Arts IELTS 7/each 5.5, old TOEFL 80/Writing25 and new4.5/Writing5. Chinese Historical Studies is the named exception at6/5.5 without the Arts Writing floor. 2025-09-01 date anchor, no generic English-medium waiver guarantee.
boundaries.formats: Per-exam TOEFL Home exclusions only where programme-specific evidence read. IELTS Indicator, One Skill Retake and combined results remain manually reviewed where applicable; one complete result does not forbid multiple attempts.
boundaries.alternatives: Art History, Hong Kong History, Music and PPE accept other degrees with substantial art/musical/prior-study evidence; no automatic mismatch rejection or conversion to work-years. MAES specific English-major source is retained despite abbreviated portal.
boundaries.regional: Exact JLPT/TOPIK/TORFL and French/German/Spanish CEFR requirements retained as documentary conditions. Portal generic CEFL B2 wording does not broaden accepted regional languages. Optional trips do not prove compulsory overseas delivery.
boundaries.mixedYears: MAAL own fee page quotes 2026; MALCS current header/PDF and old 2025/26 body kept separate. HK History current portal proposed amount versus school To be confirmed is explicit. Linguistics old preferred/Division2 versus portal major condition unresolved, not converted to GPA.
boundaries.dates: All exact noon cutoffs retained. MAAL FT/PT clearing differs by a month. MALCS header opening12Oct2026 noon is stored at calendar-date precision with an explicit intraday limit. No scholarship deadline or generic semester month becomes an exact admission/start date.
